agent_notes: Lane IP 2026-10-22: invertebrate predation, German blue ram vs shrimp. Quotes from WebFetch extraction output, no verify run yet. No page gives a prey length: gbr prey.mm 30 (an adult cherry shrimp) and prey.young 60 (past an adult Amano) are est.; inverts: 'shrimp' (the rule targets shrimp, so snails are not prey of rams) is est.: no page reports rams eating snails, Aquatic Arts lists snails as safe.

sources.states: rams ate most of a cherry shrimp colony

sources.quote: I had problems with some stunning rams in a heavily planted 200l eating juvenile shrimp
If they are larger shrimp they tend to fare a little better and be left alone

sources.states: safe with larger shrimp and snails
sources.quote: German Blue Ram Cichlids are peaceful and safe to keep with larger species of shrimp, snails

sources.states: cherry shrimp with rams: possible but requires caution
sources.quote: Keeping Cherry Shrimp and German Blue Ram together is possible but requires caution

prey.note: Pages split (UKAPS: some keepers saw no losses); we flag a cherry colony as eaten (shrimplets always are) and Amanos as large-adults-only. One UKAPS post reports rams hunting Amanos as big as themselves, so the Amano advisory is a floor, not a promise.
